changelog:
- Total Removal of Homescreen Bottom Bar: Guaranteed complete removal of bottom native bar on the start page across app resume, orientation change, and initial load.
- Restored All Feature Buttons: Registered FokkShieldBridge directly on WebView instantiation and protected against lifecycle detachment, making Favorites, History, AdShield, Settings, Tab Switcher, and Three-Dots Menu fully functional.
- Synchronized Search Engine: Command Card automatically matches user's active native default engine on startup.
